name: Clumpy galaxy J232423-000624 (Hubble)
blurb: J232423-000624, a clumpy galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: clumpygalaxyj232423000624-hubble
story: A galaxy studded with clumps of star formation like those in young galaxies of the early universe, one of 381 targets in a Hubble survey of such look-alikes.

claims.text: HST program 17309 (Cycle 32 snapshot, PI Vihang Mehta) is titled Resolved imaging survey of the analogs of high-z massive, star-forming clumps
The survey images 381 clumpy galaxies with ACS in F435W and F775W
The clumps are analogous to those in high-redshift star-forming galaxies
